shorts.title: A False Killer Whale Offered a Researcher a 34-Kilo Tuna
shorts.outro: Doug got offered one too. It went worse. Full video below.
shorts.description: In 1984 off Kona, Hawaii, a false killer whale swam at researcher Dan McSweeney with most of a yellowfin tuna and let it go, then the group shared it; the full false killer whale episode is linked below.

shorts.title: This Whale Offered People Salmon, Then Took It Back
shorts.outro: Doug's six deaths this episode are in the full video below.
shorts.description: A lone false killer whale off British Columbia and Washington kept dropping big salmon beside boats and grabbing them back as they sank; Doug's six deaths are in the full episode.

shorts.title: Two Whales Pinned a 3-Meter Swordfish Between Them
shorts.outro: Doug tried to measure one. That's in the full video below.
shorts.description: Off Lanai, Hawaii, in 2024 two false killer whales were photographed with a broadbill swordfish about three meters long between them; the full false killer whale episode is linked below.
